evidence: Normative multi-account bridge contract derived from TECHNICAL_SPECIFICATION.md sections 6.4, 6.5 and 6.6, ADR-0002 section 7, ADR-0003 section 8 and the Phase 0 environment probe: OpenCode has no external multi-account plugins, Codex uses separate `.codex_*` profiles, and no quota API was confirmed. No credentials, tokens or private user paths are included.

sanitization.note: Probe-local identifiers were replaced with fixed placeholders; secret values are never recorded.

routingAuthority.rule: The application Routing Engine is the only component that selects an account/route for a GUI-managed session.

isolationModel.accountBoundaryFallback: If pin/isolation inside one instance cannot be proven, the instance boundary narrows to a single account.
isolationModel.credentials: Credentials stay with OpenCode/plugin or in Windows secret storage; the application never extracts or displays OAuth refresh tokens.
forbidden: cross-account execution inside one instance without proven isolation

bridgeCapabilities.unsupportedBehavior: A plugin without pin or observed route evidence is not admitted to automatic multi-account modes and is exposed as one opaque provider route.

pin.scope: per execution and per native session binding

autoRotation.opaquePluginRoute: one opaque provider route that is excluded from automatic multi-account modes

conditions: observedRoute is missing while the routing mode requires route evidence
observedRoute differs from requestedRoute in any binding field
the pin was rejected or silently ignored by the backend/plugin
plugin auto-rotation changed account/model/variant after the pin
outcomes: the execution is not counted as success
automatic failover and prompt resend are forbidden
requestedRoute and observedRoute evidence is preserved and shown to the user

bindingPriority: explicit user selection for the new session
logical role binding of the active workflow version

routingModes.description: binding is selected once and kept until Reset/Close
routingModes.onIneligibility: stop the next turn and propose a replacement session; the prompt is not sent before user confirmation

routingModes.description: quota plus health plus load plus latency

eligibilityGates: quota gate passes per mode-specific rules
project data classification does not exceed route maxDataClass

dataSensitivity.rule: A route may receive data only up to its maxDataClass; credentials and discovered secrets are never sent.

failoverRules: before the first prompt automatic modes may choose another eligible account
after session confirmation or possible prompt delivery automatic resend is forbidden
Pinned and ManualOnly never perform automatic failover
SessionSticky stops the next turn on ineligibility and proposes a replacement session
failover never changes backend, provider profile, model, reasoning, speed or mode
Ambiguous executions are never resent automatically and do not consume the workflow retry budget

quotaPolicy.sharedSnapshotReference: Dashboard and Routing Engine must reference the same quotaSnapshotId.
